message:
docs(field): pipeUs is capture stamp -> pre-enqueue send-ready time, not capture->wire

hdr.sendQpcUs is stamped on the main thread before the sender queue
(host_stage_encode_send_h264_au.cpp:268); only the wire copy item.udpHdr.sendQpcUs is restamped
at send time (host_encoded_sender.cpp:175). The user-feedback pipeUs sample therefore includes
the encoder hold but excludes sender-queue wait and the actual UDP send, and its capture stamp
may be a corrected one. Report section 3 and history #399 renamed accordingly; the
'capture->wire distribution unmeasured' conclusion stands.
